messages:
olivia: hey all, first day hiccup. restored my MBP M2 from a Time Machine backup of my personal mac. Kandji shows the device enrolled but my local account is named "olivia-personal" (not company olivia) and i get "user olivia-personal is not in the sudoers file". SSH pubkey didn't populate (it wrote to /Users/olivia/.ssh but my active home is /Users/olivia-personal). FileVault status is confusing: `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On" but Kandji says "No FV escrow". also corp VPN cert won't install because profile targets the managed username. who can help map my user to the managed account or give temp admin? :wave:

it-rafa: welcome olivia! odd restore path. can you paste serial and `id -u olivia-personal` vs `id -u olivia` outputs? if the managed user (olivia) exists but is not the logged-in one, we can add your active user to company temp-admins, or we can rehome the files. also paste `ls -ld /Users/olivia*` so we can see ownership.

olivia: serial C02ABC1DEF2G. `id -u olivia-personal` -> 501, `id -u olivia` -> no user. `ls -ld /Users/olivia*` -> `/Users/olivia-personal  drwxr-xr-x  35  olivia-personal  staff  1120 Mar 20 10:02 /Users/olivia-personal`

mdm-lina: thanks. looks like the restore created a local-only account and our enrollment created the device but not the managed user record. i'll push a provisioning profile that creates the managed `olivia` user and migrate SSH keys/home files, and I'll grant 90m temp admin while we run the migration so you can verify. prefer to avoid wiping the machine.

onboard-bot: Job queued: create_managed_user_and_migrate -> device=C02ABC1DEF2G (job=99001)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_temp_admin_99002 -> device=C02ABC1DEF2G
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_temp_admin_99002 -> success (olivia-personal added to /etc/sudoers.d/company-temp-admins)

mdm-lina: pushed the managed-user creation profile. it will create /Users/olivia and set olivia as managed with proper UID mapping. migration script will copy .ssh and app config from /Users/olivia-personal to /Users/olivia and fix perms. once that's done we'll escrow the FileVault key and push the VPN cert. ETA ~15m.

olivia: seeing a new user "olivia" at login screen. logged into olivia and ran `ls -la /Users/olivia/.ssh` -> empty for now. i still have temp admin in the original account.

mdm-bot: Deployment started: migrate_home_99003 -> device=C02ABC1DEF2G
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: migrate_home_99003 -> success (files copied, permissions fixed)

mdm-lina: migration complete. we copied authorized_keys and fixed ownership. can you log into the managed user and verify `ssh -T git@github.com` and that you can `sudo`? we'll escrow FV after you confirm.

olivia: logged into olivia, `ssh -T git@github.com` -> success (Hi olivia! You've successfully authenticated). `sudo -v` now works. fdesetup still says On and Kandji now shows "FV escrow pending".

mdm-lina: pushing FV escrow script and VPN cert now. leaving temp admin for 90 minutes. we'll revoke when you're done.

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_fv_escrow_99004 -> device=C02ABC1DEF2G
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_fv_escrow_99004 -> success (fv_key_escrowed)
mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_vpn_profile_99005 -> device=C02ABC1DEF2G
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_vpn_profile_99005 -> success (vpn_cert_installed)

olivia: vpn connects, ssh works from managed account, and i can `sudo`. home dir migration looks good. thanks! :tada: quick q — should I delete /Users/olivia-personal now or keep it as a backup?

it-rafa: leave it for 48h as backup, then remove if everything looks fine. we'll revoke temp admin after you ack. filing follow-up to add a note to the new-hire checklist about avoiding Time Machine restores during initial enroll.

olivia: removed a few temp files and double-checked configs. ok to revoke temp admin. thanks for the fast help everyone! :raised_hands:

mdm-bot: Temporary admin revoked: olivia-personal -> removed from /etc/sudoers.d/company-temp-admins. closing job 99002.
